Welcome to the Godot MCP Toolkit!

This plugin exposes your Godot editor to AI agents via MCP.
Some tools can modify your project or execute arbitrary code.

Risk is communicated per-tool via MCP annotations.
For details and copy-pasteable agent blocking configs, see:
  addons/godot_mcp_toolkit/docs/security-recommendations.md

All tools are available by default. Use your agent's
allowlist/blocklist to restrict specific tools if needed.
